subject: a young Englishwoman of the 1830s and 1840s with dark hair parted in the middle and gathered in soft ringlets at the sides, an elegant high-waisted satin gown with full sleeves, a thoughtful, intelligent, focused expression

panels.01-flyology: a twelve-year-old English girl in an 1820s dress at a wooden table in a sunlit country house room, studying the wing of a bird beside paper sketches of wing designs and feathers, birds flying past the open window, 1828, curiosity
panels.02-recovery: a thirteen-year-old English girl resting in a canopy bed in an 1820s English bedroom, propped on pillows and reading a book of geometry by window light, a pair of wooden crutches leaning nearby, calm and determined, 1829, not sad
panels.03-soiree: {S} aged seventeen in a crowded candlelit London drawing room at an 1833 evening party, being introduced by an older lady scientist to a middle-aged Victorian gentleman inventor with side whiskers in a dark frock coat, guests in period evening dress
panels.04-engine: {S} aged seventeen leaning close to examine a gleaming brass calculating machine of stacked toothed wheels and number columns in a London workshop drawing room, 1833, a middle-aged gentleman inventor turning its crank handle, wonder
panels.05-letters: {S} at a writing desk in a quiet Victorian study by lamplight, reading a letter full of mathematical symbols and writing a reply with a quill pen, stacks of mathematics books, 1840
panels.06-translation: {S} at a large desk covered in papers, translating a printed French journal into English with a quill, notes pinned around her, a winter window behind, London 1842, concentration
panels.07-noteg: {S} standing at a desk spread with a large hand-drawn table of mathematical operations, a stack of punched cards and the wooden frame of a Jacquard loom in the background, brass gears of a calculating mill nearby, golden lamplight, 1843, a moment of vision and triumph
panels.08-legacy: an elderly Victorian gentleman inventor with white side whiskers writing his memoirs by lamplight in a cluttered London study in 1864, a bound printed volume of scientific memoirs open beside him at a page of tables, brass gear wheels on the shelf, respectful remembrance
